title: Prismatic Customer Structure
description: JSON Structure representation of a Prismatic Customer — a company or organization that uses your product and to which integration instances are deployed.
name: Customer

name.description: Display name of the customer organization.

externalId.description: Customer identifier as known in your own system.

allowEmbeddedDesigner.description: Whether the embedded designer is enabled for this customer.

instances.description: Integration instances deployed to the customer.
